segments.text: 此開卷第一回也．作者自云：因曾歷過一番夢幻之后，故將真事隱去，而借"通靈"之說，撰此《石頭記》一書也．故曰"甄士隱"云云．但書中所記何事何人？自又云：“今風塵碌碌，一事無成，忽念及當日所有之女子，一一細考較去，覺其行止見識，皆出于我之上．何我堂堂須眉，誠不若彼裙釵哉？實愧則有余，悔又無益之大無可如何之日也！當此，則自欲將已往所賴天恩祖德，錦衣紈褲之時，飫甘饜肥之日，背父兄教育之恩，負師友規談之德，以至今日一技無成，半生潦倒之罪，編述一集，以告天下人：我之罪固不免，然閨閣中本自歷歷有人，万不可因我之不肖，自護己短，一并使其泯滅也．雖今日之茅椽蓬牖，瓦灶繩床，其晨夕風露，階柳庭花，亦未有妨我之襟怀筆墨者．雖我未學，下筆無文，又何妨用假語村言，敷演出一段故事來，亦可使閨閣昭傳，复可悅世之目，破人愁悶，不亦宜乎？"故曰"賈雨村"云云．

glosses.content: 此開卷第一回也: This is the opening chapter of the book. Grammar: topic-comment clause; 也 marks a declarative/explanatory ending
作者自云: the author himself says Grammar: 自 is reflexive/emphatic; 云 introduces a quotation
因曾歷過一番夢幻之后: because he had once undergone an episode of dream and illusion Grammar: 因 introduces reason; 曾 marks prior experience; 過 is experiential aspect; 之 links noun modifiers; 后 means 'after'
故將真事隱去: therefore he conceals the true events Grammar: 故 marks result; 將 introduces the object affected; 去 is directional/resultative
而借通靈之說: and instead borrows the account of '通靈' Grammar: 而 links clauses; 之 is an attributive linker
撰此石頭記一書也: to compose this book, The Story of the Stone Grammar: 此 demonstrative; 一書 is a numeral-classifier/noun phrase; 也 marks assertion
故曰甄士隱云云: hence the name 'Zhen Shiyin,' and so forth Grammar: 曰 introduces a name/quotation; 云云 signals 'and so on'
但書中所記何事何人: But what events and what people are recorded in the book? Grammar: 但 marks contrast; 所 + verb nominalizes 'that which is recorded'; 何 is interrogative
自又云: he himself further says Grammar: 自 is reflexive/emphatic; 又 means 'further'; 云 introduces quotation
今風塵碌碌一事無成: now, amid the dust and bustle of the world, I have accomplished nothing Grammar: 今 sets time; 碌碌 is reduplicative descriptive expression; 一事無成 is a fixed negative-result phrase
忽念及當日所有之女子: suddenly I think of the women who were there in those days Grammar: 及 means 'come to'; 所有 is 'those who/that which existed'; 之 links modifier to noun
一一細考較去: examining and comparing them one by one in detail Grammar: 一一 is distributive reduplication; 細 modifies the verbal phrase; 去 is a directional/completive complement
覺其行止見識皆出于我之上: I realize that their conduct and understanding all surpass mine Grammar: 其 is possessive; 皆 scopes over the predicate; 出于 means 'exceed/be above'; 之 links 我 to 上

何我堂堂須眉誠不若彼裙釵哉: How is it that I, a full-grown bearded man, am truly not the equal of those women? Grammar: 何 introduces rhetorical question; 誠 is an adverb 'truly'; 不若 means 'not equal to'; 哉 marks exclamation/question
實愧則有余悔又無益: I have more than enough shame, but regret is useless Grammar: 則 marks contrast/qualification; 有余 means 'more than enough'; 又 adds the second clause
之大無可如何之日也: this is a day of utter helplessness Grammar: 之 links modifiers; 無可如何 is an idiom meaning 'there is nothing one can do'; 也 closes the clause

當此則自欲將已往所賴天恩祖德: At this point, I wish to take the former days in which I relied on Heaven's grace and ancestral virtue... Grammar: 當此 means 'at this point'; 則 marks consequence; 欲 marks intention; 將 introduces the object; 所 nominalizes 賴
錦衣紈褲之時飫甘饜肥之日: the time of brocade clothes and silk trousers, the days of eating one's fill of delicacies Grammar: 之 links descriptive phrases to 時/日; paired parallel phrases

背父兄教育之恩負師友規談之德: when I went against the kindness of my father and elder brother's education, and failed the moral instruction of teachers and friends Grammar: 之 links modifiers to 恩/德; 背 and 負 are parallel verbs

以至今日一技無成半生潦倒之罪: and so came to the present with no skill accomplished—the fault of a half-life spent in failure Grammar: 以至 marks endpoint/result; 一技無成 is a compact negative construction; 之 nominalizes the preceding description as 罪's modifier
編述一集以告天下人: I compile and narrate a collection in order to tell the people under heaven Grammar: 一集 is numeral + classifier/noun; 以 introduces purpose
我之罪固不免: My guilt certainly cannot be escaped Grammar: 之 marks possession/attributive relation; 固 is an adverb 'certainly'; 不免 means 'cannot avoid'

然閨閣中本自歷歷有人: nevertheless, there have always plainly been remarkable people in the women's quarters Grammar: 然 marks concession/contrast; 本自 emphasizes 'from the beginning/inherently'; 歷歷 means clearly, distinctly

万不可因我之不肖自護己短一并使其泯滅也: one absolutely must not, because of my unworthiness, protect my own shortcomings and thereby cause them all to be obliterated Grammar: 万 (萬) is emphatic 'absolutely'; 因 introduces cause; 之 nominalizes 不肖; 使 introduces causative construction; 其 refers back to those women/people; 也 closes the assertion
雖今日之茅椽蓬牖瓦灶繩床: Although today I have thatched rafters and a humble window, an earthen stove and a rope bed Grammar: 雖 introduces concessive clause; 之 links 今日 to its description
其晨夕風露階柳庭花: its morning and evening winds and dew, the willows by the steps and flowers in the courtyard Grammar: 其 is possessive; paired time/place phrases create parallel imagery
亦未有妨我之襟怀筆墨者: these things still do not hinder my mind and my writing Grammar: 亦 means 'also/still'; 未有妨 is 'have not hindered'; 之 links 我 to 襟懷筆墨; 者 nominalizes the clause/subject
雖我未學下筆無文: Although I am unlearned and have no literary skill when I put brush to paper Grammar: 雖 introduces concession; 未 marks lack/not having; 下筆 is 'put brush to paper'

又何妨用假語村言敷演出一段故事來: why should it matter if I use fictive words and rustic speech to develop a story? Grammar: 何妨 is rhetorical 'why should it matter'; 用 introduces means; 敷演 is coordinated verb; 出/來 are directional-resultative complements

亦可使閨閣昭傳: it can also cause the women of the inner chambers to be made manifest and transmitted Grammar: 可 marks possibility; 使 introduces causative construction; 昭傳 means 'be clearly made known and passed down'
复可悅世之目破人愁悶: and can also delight the eyes of the world and dispel people's sorrow and distress Grammar: 复 (復) means 'also/further'; 之 links 世 to 目; 破 is transitive 'dispel'
不亦宜乎: would that not be appropriate? Grammar: 不亦...乎 is a rhetorical question pattern: 'is it not also...?'

hence the name 'Jia Yucun,' and so forth
故 marks conclusion; 曰 introduces the name; 云云 signals 'and so on'
